sections.heading: What Is a Bulk SMS Service?

blocks.html: A bulk SMS service lets a business send large volumes of text messages — order updates, OTPs, appointment reminders, offers — to customers through an API or dashboard rather than one message at a time. Behind the scenes, an SMS gateway routes each message through registered telecom operators, checking it against DLT records before it ever reaches a handset.

items.title: Two broad message types:
items.desc: Transactional SMS (OTPs, alerts, confirmations) and promotional SMS (offers, announcements) — each governed by different consent and timing rules.

items.title: Works without an app or data plan:
items.desc: SMS reaches any mobile number instantly, including feature phones and areas with patchy internet — a reach no app-based channel can fully replace.

sections.heading: DLT Compliance: The Non-Negotiable First Step

blocks.html: No bulk SMS company in Bangalore can legally deliver a commercial message without DLT registration — the TRAI-mandated system that verifies your entity, sender ID and message templates before any operator will carry your traffic. A provider that does not walk you through this properly is setting you up for silent failures later.

items.title: Three linked registrations:
items.desc: Your business entity, your sender ID (header) and your exact message template all need to be registered and matched correctly.

sections.heading: Common Mistakes Businesses Make Sending Bulk SMS

blocks.html: Most delivery problems trace back to a handful of avoidable mistakes, not a broken network.

items.title: Sending before DLT registration is complete:
items.desc: Messages are blocked outright, not delayed — there is no partial delivery for unregistered senders.

items.title: Ignoring DND status on promotional sends:
items.desc: Promotional SMS to DND-listed numbers gets scrubbed at the operator level every time.

items.title: Sending promotions outside permitted hours:
items.desc: Promotional SMS is restricted to daytime hours under TRAI rules — transactional messages are not.

items.title: Not testing a template before a full send:
items.desc: A single unapproved character can fail an entire campaign at scale — test small, then scale up.

sections.heading: Frequently Asked Questions About Bulk SMS in Bangalore

items.q: What is a bulk SMS service provider and does my Bangalore business need one?
items.a: A bulk SMS service provider sends large volumes of text messages — OTPs, order updates, offers — through an API or dashboard on your behalf. Any business messaging customers at scale, from a single-location store to a national fintech, needs one to reach numbers reliably and stay compliant.

items.q: How do I choose the best bulk SMS service provider in Bangalore?
items.a: Check that the provider actively guides DLT registration, shows transparent delivery reports with failure reasons, offers usable API documentation, and can be reached quickly if a campaign fails outside business hours.

items.q: Is DLT registration required to send bulk SMS in Bangalore?
items.a: Yes. DLT registration is mandated by TRAI for every business sending commercial SMS in India, regardless of city. Unregistered senders are blocked at the operator level before delivery.

items.q: Can a bulk SMS provider in Bangalore also support WhatsApp and voice messaging?
items.a: With Ojiva AI, yes — SMS, WhatsApp Business API, OTP and voice all run on one account, so a message that fails on one channel can fall back to another automatically.

items.q: What is the difference between transactional and promotional bulk SMS?
items.a: Transactional SMS (OTPs, order alerts) is not affected by DND restrictions and can send at any time. Promotional SMS is restricted to permitted daytime hours and blocked for numbers on the DND list.

items.q: How fast is bulk SMS delivery through Ojiva AI?
items.a: Standard campaigns deliver within seconds of sending, and OTP traffic runs on a dedicated high-throughput route so login codes are not delayed behind bulk promotional sends.

items.q: Does Ojiva AI provide API integration for bulk SMS?

items.q: What support can I expect from a bulk SMS service provider in Bangalore?
